ieee_research_paper.description: Full IEEE conference-style research paper (6-10 pages). Best for comprehensive studies with complete pipeline results, large cohorts, and rigorous methodology.
ieee_research_paper.use_when: The study has a complete pipeline run with segmentation, feature extraction, modeling, and result analysis — AND the cohort size is >= 30 patients — AND model performance is noteworthy (AUC > 0.7).

TITLE.description: Paper title derived from the hypothesis

ABSTRACT.description: 200-300 word structured abstract: Background, Purpose, Methods, Results, Conclusion

KEYWORDS.description: 5-8 comma-separated keywords from hypothesis, modality, and disease

INTRODUCTION.description: 2-3 paragraphs: clinical problem, radiomics background, study objective
INTRODUCTION.instructions: Use literature findings from context_augmentation for clinical context.

RELATED_WORK.description: Review of relevant literature and prior studies
RELATED_WORK.instructions: Use the literature_findings from the context_augmentation data and the knowledge base. Reference key papers, consensus points, and research gaps identified by the literature review agent. Cite benchmark performance from prior studies.

STUDY_POPULATION.description: Population selection methodology and cohort demographics

SEGMENTATION_METHODS.description: ROI segmentation approach and tools used

FEATURE_EXTRACTION_METHODS.description: Radiomics feature extraction and selection methodology

MODELING_METHODS.description: Machine learning modeling approach, validation strategy

FEATURE_RESULTS.description: Top features table with importance scores

MODEL_PERFORMANCE.description: Model comparison table with all metrics

DISCUSSION.description: Interpretation of results, comparison with literature, clinical implications

LIMITATIONS.description: Study limitations compiled from all agent warnings

CONCLUSION.description: 2-3 sentences: key finding, hypothesis decision, future directions

REFERENCES.instructions: Include references to PyRadiomics, ML methods used, and key domain papers from the literature review.

short_study.description: Concise study report (3-5 pages). Combines methods into a single section, includes a compact model comparison table.
short_study.use_when: The study has complete results but doesn't need the full depth of an IEEE paper — OR the cohort is moderate (15-30 patients) — OR this is meant as a preliminary or pilot study report.

ABSTRACT.description: 150-200 word abstract covering objective, methods, key results, conclusion

INTRODUCTION.description: 1-2 paragraphs: clinical context and study objective. Use literature findings for background.

STUDY_POPULATION.description: Brief cohort description: size, demographics, inclusion criteria

FEATURE_MODELING.description: Combined feature extraction and modeling methodology in one subsection

RESULTS_SUMMARY.description: 1-2 paragraphs of narrative results before the table

MODEL_COMPARISON_TABLE.description: Table rows: Model & Accuracy & AUC & Sensitivity & Specificity
MODEL_COMPARISON_TABLE.instructions: Format each model as a LaTeX table row, e.g.: Random Forest & 0.92 & 0.89 & 0.91 & 0.93 \\

KEY_FEATURES.description: Brief list of top discriminative features

one_page_abstract.description: One-page structured abstract with key metrics table. Ideal for quick summaries, conference submissions, or when only partial results are available.
one_page_abstract.use_when: The user asked for a quick summary — OR only partial pipeline results are available — OR the cohort is small (< 15 patients) — OR this is an intermediate progress report.

BACKGROUND.description: 2-3 sentences on clinical context and motivation

METHODS.description: 3-4 sentences covering: cohort, segmentation, features, modeling

RESULTS.description: 2-3 sentences with key numeric results and hypothesis decision

CONCLUSION.description: 1-2 sentences: main finding and clinical relevance

KEY_METRICS_TABLE.description: LaTeX table rows: Metric & Value pairs
KEY_METRICS_TABLE.instructions: Format as LaTeX rows, e.g.: Cohort Size & 45 \\ Best Model & Random Forest \\ AUC & 0.89 \\ Accuracy & 0.92 \\ Decision & Accepted \\

selection_criteria.description: The reporter agent should select the template based on these criteria, evaluated in order:
rules: 1. If pipeline_status is 'has_failures' or agent_count < 4, use 'one_page_abstract' (partial results only warrant a summary)
2. If any agent has status 'partial' or cohort_size < 15, use 'one_page_abstract'
3. If cohort_size >= 30 AND all agents completed AND model AUC > 0.7, use 'ieee_research_paper'
4. Otherwise, use 'short_study' as the default balanced option

filling_instructions: For each placeholder marked with <<PLACEHOLDER_NAME>> in the chosen template, replace it with appropriate LaTeX content. Use the source_agents and source_fields to locate data in agent output JSON files. Escape LaTeX special characters: % -> \%, & -> \&, _ -> \_. Tables should use booktabs (\toprule, \midrule, \bottomrule).
